page: Vultr vhp-2c-4gb-amd is a High Performance family virtual server featuring an AMD EPYC processor with 2 shared vCPUs mapped to 1 physical core and 2 threads. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the CPU operates at a clock speed of 2.0 GHz and includes 16 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core, and includes a bundled 100 GB NVMe SSD for local storage along with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark evaluations indicate entry-level performance characteristics. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng sits in the average tier at 2263.16, while multi-core performance falls into the weak category at 4483.12. Memory bandwidth is a notable constraint, with large-block read-only bandwidth registering at 20.06 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 20.37 GB/sec, both placing in the lower percentiles. Geekbench scores also reflect these limitations, yielding a single-core score of 891.0 and a multi-core score of 1596.0.

Given the shared CPU allocation and modest memory capacity, this server is positioned as a budget-friendly option for workloads with low resource demands. It is suitable for basic web serving, small-scale database operations, lightweight background tasks, and development environments. It is not recommended for memory-intensive applications, high-throughput database systems, or complex multi-threaded processing.

It features 2 shared vCPUs, 1 physical core, and 4.0 GB of system memory. Local storage is supported by a bundled 100 GB NVMe SSD. Performance benchmarks indicate modest capabilities, with average single-core stress-ng performance of 2263.16 but lower-tier multi-core and memory bandwidth results, such as a Geekbench multi-core score of 1596.0 and a large-block read-only memory bandwidth of 20.06 GB/sec. This resource profile makes the server a cost-efficient choice for lightweight workloads, including basic static web serving, development environments, and small-scale background tasks, where dedicated CPU resources are not required.
